title: 1 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 7
description: Ten questions on 1 Samuel 7: the ark at Kiriath Jearim, Israel's return to Yahweh at Mizpah, and the stone Ebenezer.

questions.text: Into whose house did the men of Kiriath Jearim bring Yahweh's ark?
questions.explanation: They brought it into Abinadab's house on the hill and consecrated Eleazar his son to keep the ark.

questions.text: When all the house of Israel lamented after Yahweh, how long had it been since the ark came to stay in Kiriath Jearim?
questions.explanation: From the day the ark stayed in Kiriath Jearim the time was long; it was twenty years, and all the house of Israel lamented after Yahweh.

questions.text: What did Samuel tell Israel to put away if they were returning to Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Samuel told them to put away the foreign gods and the Ashtaroth and to serve Yahweh only.

answers.text: The foreign gods and the Ashtaroth

questions.text: Where did Samuel tell them to gather all Israel so he could pray for them?
questions.explanation: Samuel said, "Gather all Israel to Mizpah, and I will pray to Yahweh for you."

questions.text: What did the people do with water at Mizpah?
questions.explanation: They drew water and poured it out before Yahweh, fasted that day, and confessed their sin.

answers.text: They poured it out before Yahweh
They washed the ark with it
They gave it to the priests to drink
They sprinkled it on the altar

questions.text: What did Samuel offer as a whole burnt offering to Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Samuel took a suckling lamb and offered it as a whole burnt offering to Yahweh.

questions.text: How did Yahweh confuse the Philistines when they came near to battle?
questions.explanation: Yahweh thundered with a great thunder on the Philistines that day and confused them.

answers.text: He thundered with a great thunder
He made the sun stand still

questions.text: What name did Samuel give the stone he set between Mizpah and Shen?
questions.explanation: Samuel called its name Ebenezer, saying, "Yahweh helped us until now."

questions.text: Between Israel and which people was there peace?
questions.explanation: There was peace between Israel and the Amorites.

questions.text: Where was Samuel's house, where he also built an altar?
questions.explanation: His return was to Ramah, for his house was there; he judged Israel there and built an altar to Yahweh.
